# Superhive

> > Superhive (formerly Blender Market) is a digital marketplace for Blender creators, offering addons, 3D models, and digital assets.

Superhive serves the Blender community by providing a curated marketplace where creators can buy and sell premium tools, plugins, and assets. The platform features popular products like Auto-Rig Pro, Hard Ops, Boxcutter, Retopoflow, and UVPackmaster, supporting both independent artists and established developers like Artell, Orange Turbine, TeamC, and glukoz.

## Key Topics

- Blender addons and plugins
- 3D models and digital assets
- Auto-Rig Pro
- Hard Ops and Boxcutter
- Retopoflow 4
- UVPackmaster 4
- Botaniq
- Voxel Heat Diffuse Skinning
- Creator marketplace
- Blender Market transition
- 3D workflow tools
- Mesh modeling tools
- Artell and Orange Turbine developers
- TeamC and glukoz creators

## Main

- [Superhive Homepage](https://superhivemarket.com/): Main marketplace for Blender addons, 3D models, and digital assets from creators worldwide
